target.title: fix(ui): chat workspace panel leaves an empty gap when collapsed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the session workspace panel in the Control UI chat view wasted horizontal space around its edges: the panel (collapsed or expanded) floated inside the chat content's right gutter, leaving a ~20px strip of dead background between it and the window edge, and the collapsed strip was wider than it needed to be. The result read as a broken gap rather than an intentional rail (screenshots below).

## Why This Change Was Made

The workspace rail now docks flush against the window edge in both states, like the docked terminal at the bottom of the shell:

- The chat content area drops its right gutter and squares the card's right corners (via a `:has()` override guarded to viewports >1120px, where the rail actually renders).
- The collapsed strip slims from 52px to 44px and stays a normal in-layout column — a Cursor-style slim icon rail that never overlays or floats over chat content.

No markup or component changes; the collapsed strip keeps its expand toggle and file icon, with unchanged accessibility attributes.

## User Impact

The workspace panel looks docked instead of floating: collapsed, it is a slim icon rail at the window edge; expanded, the panel closes flush with the edge. Chat content keeps its full width minus only the slim rail, and nothing ever overlays the conversation.

## Evidence

**Before** — the collapsed strip floats inside the content gutter with dead space on both sides:

![before: collapsed rail floats inside the content gutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/before-collapsed.png)

**After (collapsed)** — slim 44px icon rail docked flush to the window edge:

![after: collapsed rail is a slim docked icon strip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/after-collapsed.png)

**After (expanded)** — the open panel docks flush to the window edge (no gutter, square corners), like the bottom terminal:

![after: expanded workspace rail docked flush to the window edge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/after-expanded.png)

Validation:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts` — 92 passed (unchanged from main; no component/markup changes).
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/e2e/chat-flow.e2e.test.ts` — 19 passed (Playwright), including new flush-edge assertions (`window.innerWidth - rail.getBoundingClientRect().right === 0`) in both collapsed and expanded states, plus the existing ≤1120px viewport check where the rail hides and the gutter stays.
- Screenshots captured with the repo's Playwright e2e harness (mock gateway, light theme, 1360×860@2x).
- `oxfmt --check` and `scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` clean on touched files.
